IMPORTANT: Use a beautiful 2.5D isometric fantasy style with detailed HD pixel-art-inspired graphics. Use a camera zoomed further out, smaller characters and monsters, detailed environments, smooth animations, lighting and shadows. Do not use a flat top-down view.

Create 8 large regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include villages, dungeons, quests, monsters and bosses.

Players choose Angels or Demons, with male and female characters, hairstyles, eye colors and cosmetic options. Both factions share the world. Angels and Demons have unique wings unlocked through quests or optional shop purchases.

Create 3 distinct classes, each with unique weapons, armor, normal attacks and one powerful upgradeable main skill with 10 levels.

Include 9 equipment slots, inventory, crafting, fusion, merchants, blacksmith, storage, quests, teleporters, mounts, Gold, Gems and a player marketplace.

- All direct equipment drops are ALWAYS T3.
- Direct rarity chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%.
- Purple and higher rarities never drop directly.
- 4 identical items fuse into the next tier: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3.
- Legendary equipment is crafting-only.
- 4 matching Legendary create Mythic.
- 4 matching Mythic create Divine.
- No random item destruction.

Build a complete mobile-friendly playable game with joystick, attack button, skill button, health and mana bars, map, inventory and shop. Shop includes Gems, costumes, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings and premium membership. Purchases are test-only for now.

Use modular code, local saving and centralized configurable prices and drop rates. Prepare for future secure online multiplayer and database integration, but never pretend simulated multiplayer is real.

Build and test the actual game. Preserve working systems, fix errors and report what works.

The 2.5D graphics, zoomed-out camera and smaller character proportions are a top priority from the beginning.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA in the current repo, with 2.5D isometric zoomed-out HD pixel-art-inspired graphics, eight regions, factions/classes, combat, equipment/fusion rules, shop, quests, inventory, and local saving; then run and test the actual game.

## Requirements
- Aesthetic: beautiful 2.5D isometric fantasy, detailed HD pixel-art-inspired graphics, zoomed-out camera, small characters/monsters, detailed environments, smooth animation, lighting/shadows; explicitly not flat top-down.
- Eight large regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion, Tower of Eternity; villages, dungeons, quests, monsters, bosses.
- Factions: Angels and Demons, male/female, hairstyles, eye colors, cosmetics; shared world; faction-unique wings unlocked via quests or optional shop.
- Three classes, each with unique weapons/armor, normal attacks, one upgradeable main skill with 10 levels.
- Nine equipment slots; inventory, crafting, fusion, merchants, blacksmith, storage, quests, teleporters, mounts, Gold, Gems, player marketplace.
- Equipment: direct drops always T3; direct rarity 60% Common / 25% Grey / 10% Green / 5% Blue; Purple+ never direct; 4 identical items fuse T3→T2→T1→next-rarity T3; Legendary crafting-only; 4 matching Legendary→Mythic; 4 matching Mythic→Divine; no random destruction.
- Mobile controls: joystick, attack, skill, health/mana, map, inventory, shop. Shop includes Gems, costumes, mounts, pets, weapon effects, wings, premium membership; purchases test-only.
- Modular code, local save, centralized prices/drop rates; prepare for future secure online multiplayer/database; never pretend simulated multiplayer is real.
- Build and test actual game; preserve working systems, fix errors, report what works.
- Build request: do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them at the end.
- Screenshot checks must use small JPEGs ≤1280px wide and read only the latest image.

## Decisions
- Using a dependency-free static HTML/ES-module canvas game with procedural art (no external assets/network) for offline reliability.
- World rendered as cropped pre-rendered isometric ground plus depth-sorted procedural props/entities, ambient lighting, weather, VFX.
- No fabricated online players; UI explicitly labels the build offline/solo and includes a disabled future `OnlineSaveAdapter`.
- All content is browser-local; test shop/gem transactions are free and clearly marked test-only.
- Fusion cap chosen at Purple T1; Legendary is forge-only to honor “Legendary equipment is crafting-only” while still allowing 4 Legendary→Mythic and 4 Mythic→Divine.
- Plan to allow all eight waystones from the start for full content access (needs state change; currently only Greendale is in `waypoints`).

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected empty repo/runtime; static `index.html` is the supported entry.
- Created `js/config.js` with game constants, regions, monsters/bosses, classes, factions, wings, shop, prices, drop rates, quests, cosmetics, equipment bases.
- Created `js/state.js` with local save adapter, profile/state initialization, derived stats, inventory, fusion logic, drops, XP, quests, bounties, skill upgrades, online adapter stub.
- Created `js/art.js` (~1235 lines) with procedural hero/class/faction/wing/mount/pet art, 20+ monster types, buildings, trees, rocks, portals, waystones, props, caching.
- Created `js/world.js` (~593 lines) with deterministic 64×64 biome generation, tile ground cache, village/dungeon/wilds props, service NPCs, spawns, lights, minimap, collision, interactions.
- Created `js/game.js` (~1534 lines) with game loop, movement, combat, skills, enemies/bosses, loot pickups, quest progress, camera, resize, DPR, rendering, lighting/weather, save/travel/death/potions/mounts.
- Created `index.html` (~357 lines) with icon sprite, character creation UI, HUD, joystick/actions, all panel shells, dialogue/prompt/death/loading overlays.
- Started `styles.css` (370 lines so far): tokens, shared controls, creation screen, HUD, top bar, quest tracker, minimap, side rail, boss bar, bottom controls, toasts, region banner, overlays.
- No build/server run or browser test yet.

### Active
- Finish `styles.css` with modal/panel layouts, inventory/equipment grids, shop cards, character sheet, world map, quests, forge, marketplace, codex, dialogues/prompts, and responsive/mobile styles.
- Implement `js/ui.js` (creation logic, HUD refresh, joystick, panels, map travel, shop, forge, market, storage, quests, NPC dialogue, prompts, minimap rendering).
- Implement `js/main.js` to wire save load, UI, game start/continue.
- Fix known bugs before testing:
  - `world.js` calls undefined `orb()` in lava tile drawing.
  - `world.js` minimap service icon coordinates are wrong.
  - `state.js` `inventoryList()` has nonsensical sort branch.
  - `config.js` costume id `"gilded_ pilgrimage"` contains a space.
  - Default state lacks `mounted`; waypoints currently only Greendale.
  - `drawHero`/mount/UI previews may need scale/visual tuning for zoomed-out proportions.
- Run node syntax checks on all JS, start server on port 3002, exercise character creation + gameplay in Chromium via `playwright-cli`, capture/read JPEG screenshots, fix runtime/console errors, verify core systems.

### Blocked
- None yet.

## Next Move
1. Finish remaining CSS panel/responsive styles.
2. Implement `js/ui.js` and `js/main.js`, wire all buttons/panels/shop/fusion/storage/market/quests/teleporters/character creation.
3. Fix known bugs in `world.js`, `state.js`, `config.js`, and add `mounted` + all region waypoints.
4. Run `node --check` on all JS; launch static server on 3002 and test in browser.
5. Verify visuals/gameplay with mobile and desktop-sized JPEG screenshots; fix errors and confirm systems.
6. Update README with controls, architecture, assumptions, online-readiness notes; report tested results.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete DOM shell and all HUD/panel containers; must align ids with `ui.js`.
- `js/config.js`: central balance/drop/shop/regions/classes/quests data; fix costume id.
- `js/state.js`: save/profile/stats/inventory/fusion/quest logic; fix `inventoryList`, waypoints, mounted.
- `js/art.js`: procedural graphics; exports `drawHero`, `drawMonster`, `drawPet`, `drawWings`, `getPropSprite`, helpers.
- `js/world.js`: world generation/rendering/minimap; fix undefined `orb` and minimap coords.
- `js/game.js`: game runtime/render/combat; exposes expected UI hooks (`ui.toast`, `refreshHud`, `openPanel`, etc.).
- `styles.css`: partially complete; needs modal/panels and responsive styles.
- `README.md`: currently generic; update game docs at end.
- `start.sh`: runtime static server wrapper.
- `capture.sh`: screenshot wrapper; use `playwright-cli` for precise screenshots.

## Important Context
- No package.json and no dependencies should be added for the game; static HTML is served directly.
- The runtime start script serves project files; port is controlled by `PORT` (use 3002 for Playwright workflows).
- `playwright-cli` is installed; screenshot JPEG directly via `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=...jpg --type=jpeg`; viewport can be resized with `playwright-cli resize 1280 720`.
- `js/game.js` already calls many UI methods that must exist in `js/ui.js`: `setLoading`, `onRegionChanged`, `refreshHud`, `tick`, `setBoss`, `updateBossHp`, `bossDefeated`, `toast`, `levelUp`, `showDeath`, `hideDeath`, `flashDamage`, `flashSave`, `openNpcDialogue`, `openPanel`, `closePanel`, `regionToast`, `selectedEnemy`.

- Shop broad navigation is via `data-panel="shop"`; category tabs must be generated in `ui.js`.
- All future online functionality must remain clearly disabled and never emulate real players.
- Current work is uncommitted.

114: export function parseItemKey(key) {
115:   const [baseId, tier = 'T3', rarity = 'common'] = String(key).split('|');
116:   return { baseId, tier, rarity };
117: }

119: export function baseFor(classId, slot) {
120:   return ITEM_BASES[classId]?.[slot] || ITEM_BASES.dawnblade[slot];
121: }

123: export function itemStats(key) {
124:   const { baseId, tier, rarity } = parseItemKey(key);
125:   let slot = 'ring';
126:   for (const cls of Object.values(ITEM_BASES)) {
127:     for (const [s, data] of Object.entries(cls)) if (data.key === baseId) slot = s;
128:   }
129:   const slotDef = SLOTS.find((s) => s.key === slot) || SLOTS[0];
130:   const tierMult = TIERS[tier]?.mult || 1;
131:   const rarityMult = RARITIES[rarity]?.power || 1;
132:   const power = tierMult * rarityMult;
133:   const attack = Math.round((slotDef.stat === 'attack' ? slotDef.base : 0) * power);
134:   const armor = Math.round((slotDef.stat === 'armor' ? slotDef.base : 0) * power);
135:   const vitality = Math.round((VITALITY_BASE[slot] || 1) * power);
136:   return { attack, armor, vitality, score: attack * 3 + armor * 2 + vitality * 4 };
137: }

139: export function itemInfo(key) {
140:   const { baseId, tier, rarity } = parseItemKey(key);
141:   let base = null;
142:   let slot = 'ring';
143:   for (const cls of Object.values(ITEM_BASES)) {
144:     for (const [s, data] of Object.entries(cls)) {
145:       if (data.key === baseId) { base = data; slot = s; }
146:     }
147:   }
148:   if (!base) base = { key: baseId, name: baseId.replace(/_/g, ' ') };
149:   return {
150:     key, ...parseItemKey(key), baseId, slot,
151:     name: base.name,
152:     tierName: TIERS[tier]?.name || tier,
153:     rarityName: RARITIES[rarity]?.name || rarity,
154:     rarityColor: RARITIES[rarity]?.color || '#ccc',
155:     stats: itemStats(key),
156:   };
157: }

159: export function itemValue(key) {
160:   const info = itemInfo(key);
161:   const tier = TIERS[info.tier]?.order || 3;
162:   const rarity = RARITIES[info.rarity]?.power || 1;
163:   return Math.round((18 + info.stats.score * 0.55) * (4 - tier) * rarity);
164: }
